experiments.hypothesis: Profile: share of cycles per phase, ours against C5 and Rust

experiments.hypothesis: Pointer walk over sparse chunks (27 to 11 instructions per 8 ORs)

experiments.hypothesis: Lone prime 13 skips the fused group loop
experiments.note: Merged into hc/champion.

experiments.hypothesis: Two gangs per step on top of hc-035

experiments.hypothesis: Sparse loop in the Zig form: counted, unrolled by 4, unsigned indices

experiments.hypothesis: Branch-free single tail mark per plane in sparse_prime

experiments.hypothesis: Unsigned arithmetic in start_bit (Zig form)
experiments.note: Merged into hc/champion (059b8f3). Explains most of the Zig sparse lead on Zen 5.

experiments.hypothesis: Unsigned division in apply_group phase, sparse rounds, is_composite
experiments.note: The cost was all in start_bit (hc-045).
